newsitem.title: UK: Iraq tells OPEC June output/supply 700k bpd-OPECNA.
newsitem.headline: Iraq tells OPEC June output/supply 700k bpd-OPECNA.

text.p: Iraq told OPEC it produced and supplied 700,000 barrels per day (bpd) in June, about half its May average, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said on Wednesday.
The data were submitted directly to OPEC headquarters in Vienna.
Iraq suspended exports in late May after reaching the $2 billion cash ceiling included in the terms of the U.N. oil-for-food deal.
The deal was renewed on June 8 but Baghdad has held off from resuming exports until a new aid distribution plan has been accepted.
Algeria, meanwhile, told OPEC it produced 802,000 bpd and supplied 800,000 bpd to the market in June, 50,000 bpd above its quota.
